capabilities.problem: A short-lived execution cannot retain interleaved native questions, typed request identities or ambiguous dispatch outcomes for a project session.
capabilities.mechanism: Build a persistent injected JSON-RPC pump with a required durable event sink, mandatory binding checks before every write, exact native request answers and unusable connections after ambiguous dispatch. Store immutable project/index/thread bindings and exclusive process-held owners in SQLite with atomic state events; recovery preserves known-unsent queues and retired answers while uncertain work becomes unknown. Journal deduplicated intents and native requests; exact owner/epoch, typed RPC ID, thread and intent-hash claims precede dispatch, one native turn can belong to only one start, and resolved queued answers retire atomically. Unknown work blocks dispatch, and RPC acknowledgements cannot prove turn completion. Exhaust bounded thread/turn/item history cursors and reject incomplete or conflicting observations; history is not an atomic snapshot or dispatch authority. Atomically save complete validated protocol frames and state projections, retain semantic conflicts in quarantine, and join out-of-order replies with exactly bound terminals. A separate recording channel now saves raw BLOBs and paired I/O intent/result observations, including malformed or partial bytes, with bounded storage and single-use epochs. Persistence failures stop read/write while close still attempts cleanup; oversized reads retain explicit incomplete prefixes and an I/O-to-commit crash may lose bytes. Passive notices, write counts and outgoing intentions do not prove native delivery or execution. Controller wiring and production launch remain separate, unadmitted work. A read-only bridge joins a saved outgoing frame to contiguous intent/result suffix writes; complete observed writes grant no authentication or execution authority. Answer shape validation can run without I/O. An independently testable construction context validates the channel, epoch and mandatory frame sink before binding, preserves failed single-use epochs, and closes an established recording channel once. Fault-event persistence and observed close evidence stay distinct; recovery under a newly supplied owner and epoch never adopts an old connection or upgrades unknown work. The context has no action dispatch or launcher. The complete injected controller reuses that context, saves local and native intents before dispatch, deduplicates answers and explicit interrupts, and preserves unknown outcomes without resend. Request resolution remains distinct from turn completion; caller callbacks and observed writes confer no native authentication or execution authority. A server-owned facade authenticates the principal before project access and binds the private source root, index and input version. Public opaque references route saved native requests and turns; durable API intents and same-key replay never retry an unobserved dispatch. Callbacks do not attest native authentication or lifecycle. An explicit loopback HTTP listener enforces exact Host/Origin and bearer authentication, bounded JSON bodies/responses, a pre-thread connection cap and an absolute socket deadline across request line, headers and body. Deadline or response loss never retries or cancels an admitted action; its handler retains the slot until completion. No launcher or native authority is added. A separate original navy Wiki overlay uses in-memory credentials and opaque project/version references for answer, decline, cancel, interrupt and read-only action recovery; browser intent keys persist without credentials or answers and unknown submissions never automatically resend. Original reference assets remain byte pinned and historical WorkspaceIndex session status is unchanged.

hard_measures: an opt-in real browser/local-service fixture records actual source origins/hashes and two synthetic project bindings; stale, incomplete, mixed-origin, dirty or cached candidates fail admission without fallback or native calls
accepted Wiki assets retain their original hashes; a separate same-origin panel exposes only opaque session targets, holds uncertain submissions and reads durable action keys without native I/O

HTTP rejects cross-origin/host, duplicate safety headers, invalid JSON and oversized bodies before dispatch; excess sockets create no handler, trickled line/header/body expires at the absolute deadline, and lost responses recover from read-only action history without resend
fresh SQLite writer, new owner and connection epoch preserve API crash gaps without resending; a failed post-recording fault event remains distinct from durable close evidence
project/principal/version checks precede dispatch; exact saved request and turn targets stay server-side; concurrent or reconstructed API replay and history reads produce no duplicate write

bound answers, explicit decisions and interrupts preserve exact request identity, durable admission and no-resend recovery; stale, partial, malformed and owner-loss observations never become terminal proof

construction fails before binding on invalid channel, epoch or sink; post-binding failures preserve fault or explicit unobserved fault plus separate close evidence, and SQLite reopen does not reuse an old epoch
a full-frame observation requires exact persisted outgoing bytes, current owner/project/epoch and contiguous positive counted suffix writes; incomplete, changed or incoming-only evidence is rejected

typed IDs, connection epochs, raw messages and failures remain distinct; source bytes, source caches, dependency SHA/index and physical tracked bytes versus verified retained raw Git blobs are checked before dispatch without clean-filter normalization

cross-thread and mismatched RPC receipts are rejected; start-turn claims are unique, known-unsent queues survive recovery, and stale answers persist as retired with requested/applied transition evidence before any I/O

raw read bytes, write intents and observed counts have append-only owner/epoch/sequence evidence; failed result persistence retains unmatched intents, rejects later read/write and never reopens a used epoch
metric_effects.human_judgment: Core review assesses trace sufficiency; synthetic protocol checks do not establish native Windows execution or research quality.

guardrails: no implicit reconnect, turn creation, retries or default approvals
caller owns durable persistence, project authority and admitted process lifecycle
no production launcher, frozen input access, model calls or scientific score changes

capabilities.problem: The Wiki reference displays synthetic papers and cannot reconcile a real partial Stage 1 package across its graph, notes, catalog and bibliography.
capabilities.mechanism: Wrap saved Stage 1 records with a deterministic, externally hash-bound read-only WorkspaceIndex and English HTML view. Reuse record validation, safe file boundaries and the existing bibliography producer; retain source levels, claim relations, coverage, input identities and failed attempts without launching research or scoring. Optionally attach an externally accepted private repair overlay with exact source passages, original-to-atomic mappings, preserved failures and separate core findings; v1 inputs and scientific states remain unchanged. The optional accepted repair overlay is projected into English HTML, version-bound Markdown, Excel/CSV, core findings and a complete bibliography with independent source, assertion and unresolved states. An offline saved-byte reader can explicitly produce a new hash-bound extraction manifest from v1/v2 source receipts using a pinned local parser. The separately attached WorkspaceIndex v3 binds that manifest, its exact work/source/version identities, source bytes, locators and metadata provenance while preserving every legacy field. The CLI and read-only presentation export the accepted overlay into HTML, Wiki, Excel/CSV, Markdown and BibTeX without parser execution, source acquisition or scientific promotion. The local literature graph uses a deterministic bounded layout, distinct work/version nodes, recorded classification/role edges, pointer and keyboard navigation, and hash-bound reference assets; interaction changes no canonical evidence.

capabilities.problem: A per-topic gold paper list and manual source annotations block routine cross-topic Stage 1 assessment.
capabilities.mechanism: Freeze topic needs and rubric v3, collect bounded public-source evidence, extract all answer chunks separately for works and central claims, select source-bound spans with independent tool-free judges, and replay only validated v3.1 units with identical inputs and runtime. Recheck public-source bytes through the bound, documented source validate CLI and append raw validation observations instead of importing private research-hub Python helpers. Reconstruct a separate complete source audit view from replay-validated catalogue records, preserving full abstracts, distinct identity metadata, versions, raw-source hashes and explicit cutoff exclusions without changing historical packets. Complete routing assigns every phase span. The separate P3 execution path submits all units independently for R1/R2, retains per-span dispositions and original locations, and aggregates bounded pairs with preserved child bindings and contrary evidence; semantic disagreement triggers ADJ. The evaluator now executes complete content criteria, process criteria and separate grounded issue review. Every complete native judging unit binds an inspectable source-audit view manifest with judge/source roles, target and unit IDs, exact view digests, unavailable states and explicit scope exclusions; oversized prompts fail without truncation or scoring. Explicit versioned offline reason-format recovery authenticates historical native calls and full source-window plans before importing separate provenance; the sole format delta raises explanatory reason length from 400 to 1024 without new calls or changed verdicts. Execution and offline recovery share the v3.1 origin-based capture inventory constructor so authenticated saved source-audit packet hashes are reproduced exactly; legacy v3.0 packet construction remains unchanged. Explicit accepted-pr65-pr67-v1 manifest opt-in admits only the three independently reviewed old/new byte pairs for observer and packet construction; undeclared, incomplete or unrelated code changes remain rejected. Complete judge audit views use the same 1024-character reason bound as source units, preserving recovered reasons without truncation. A separate source-audit-view-reason-v2 declaration binds all four exact old/new code pairs; the earlier declaration stays unchanged. Unfiltered bounded content views rank spans using every extracted work and central claim under unchanged per-file, per-work and total limits. Claim-support scores require text bound to a cited central-claim work; full support requires text for every cited work and rejects unbound central claims. Unknown evidence and observed partial support remain distinct.

hard_measures: subject claims, source levels, exact passages, unknowns, and raw acquisition receipts are separate
metric_effects.human_judgment: Independent rubric-evidence judges assess source support; automated agreement alone is not expert truth.

A versioned separate-VM adapter collects one guest probe at a time, authenticates own-slot admission, drops native processes to the subject account, retains passive observation and original capture verification, and advances one outside controller registry only after hash-verified portable transfers. No guest receives another arm or the controller registry; failures retain reservations. V2 guest lifecycle separates disposable diagnostic UID functional smoke from actual-subject non-model admission/capture. Signed receipts bind runtime/plugin/configuration, actual identity and task/result. Bilateral kernel access and retirement checks prohibit readable diagnostic storage; local defaults remain unchanged. Sudo policy admission accepts only a complete account-and-local-host-bound no-grants sentence with status zero or one and empty stderr; grant lists, mixed diagnostics and unknown states fail closed.
